name: Casting Melt Reality grants Gift of the Timeways' haste buff (#533)
contract: Gift of the Timeways 704487 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 503903 (periodic haste for Timerend/Unmake), but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the magic class damage of Melt Reality (100% chance), a single Melt Reality cast should grant the buff.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Gift of the Timeways buff before any cast
Melt Reality's cast grants the Gift of the Timeways haste buff
